**Antim sthiti: charo items puro kiye. Environment ka nam-nirdisht exhaustive sweep khali nikla, isliye mukhya deliverable (top enriched KEGG_2019_Mouse pathway) "environment-blocked, undetermined" hi rakha hai — koi pathway naam / NES / p / q / KEGG membership memory se nahi डाला। बाकी सब executed + reproducible hai.**

**1) Environment punar-prapti ka antim sweep (ek hi pass, sab mounts par) — kya-kya check kiya, sab KHALI:**
- Interpreters: `python3` = 3.12.14 (.actor-venv); `python3.14`/`/usr/bin/python` = 3.14.4 → sirf Ubuntu system `dist-packages` (Brlapi, PIL, PyGObject, ansible_collections…); `gseapy|pydeseq2|kegg|mygene|pyensembl` ka koi naam nahi. `/opt/conda`, `~/miniconda3`, `/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages`, `/usr/lib/python3.14/dist-packages` = **absent**; `/usr/local/lib/python3.14/dist-packages` = **empty**.
- pip offline: `pip config list` → khaali; `env | grep -i proxy|index|_URL` → **koi proxy/INDEX_URL nahi**; `~/.cache/pip`, `/var/cache/pip`, `/var/cache/apt/archives`, `/opt|/srv|/workspace/wheelhouse` → **absent**. `/usr/share/python-wheels` me sirf pip+setuptools; `pip install --no-index --find-links ... gseapy|pydeseq2` → "no matching distribution".
- Archive-aware (archive ke ANDAR bhi listing): /usr, NFS home, /workspace ke saare `.zip/.tar/.tar.gz/.tgz/.egg/.whl` (CUDA nsightee, libreoffice images, guestfs supermin, qemu vdso, ansible test-fixtures, pkg_resources test eggs, dateutil zoneinfo) → **zero hits** for `kegg|*.gmt|gseapy|deseq|gene_info`.
- Filename sweep: `*.gmt*`, `*KEGG*`, `*enrichr*`, `*gene_info*`, `*.ens`, `*ens2sym*`, `*ensembl*map*` → sirf hamari apni khali `out/ens2symbol_used.tsv`. Bundled fixtures bhi check (koi sample GMT kahin nahi).
- Volumes: `/data /mnt /media /srv /opt /inputs /capsule` sab absent; sirf /workspace (rw NFS) + read-only tool mounts.
→ **gseapy + KEGG_2019_Mouse + Ensembl→symbol teeno genuinely absent**; GSEA stage script ne phir se khud block declare kiya (log me "NOT EXECUTED").

**3) Ranking metric — pre-specified, fixed, log + summary.json me written:**
`gsea_metric = shrunken log2FC × (−log10 RAW Wald p)` (= sign·|lfc|·−log10p), aapke sujhaav ke anusaar; rationale: filter pehle se p/|lfc|/baseMean thresholds handle karta hai, lekin ranked list ko effect size + significance dono rakhne honge. Pure shrunken-log2FC list bhi likhi (`ranked_KLvsWL_log2fconly.tsv`), kyunki choice top pathway badal sakti hai. **Handling rules (deterministic):** p==0 (5 genes, float underflow) → 1e-300 floor (−log10p = 300, koi infinite weight nahi); NaN p/SE wale 5,984 genes dropped; baseMean<1 excluded; ties (47 metric ties) break = (shrunk log2FC desc, geneID asc); duplicate symbols (many-Ensembl→one-symbol) MEAN se collapse; unmapped genes enrichment se bahar par CSV me retained; sets min_size 15 / max_size 500.
**Is choice ka naap-chaala prabhav:** Spearman(metric, shrunken log2FC) = **0.998**, lekin top-200 me se sirf **173/200** shared → 27 top genes differ, arthat metric choice cosmetic nahi hai.

**4) KL3 + normalization sensitivity (GSEA ke bina, abhi executed):**
- **Robust size factors** (expressed-gene reference): sf = 1.034,1.045,**0.821**,1.030,1.080,1.013 → **DE 720 vs 722, Jaccard 0.983, Spearman 1.000** → 722-gene set normalization artifact **nahi** hai.
- **Leave-one-out** (subset par dobara normalize→disperse→shrink→filter): drop KL3 → DE 967, Jaccard 0.607, ρ 0.910, λ 4.30 | drop KL1 → 596, 0.760, ρ 0.969 | drop KL2 → 595, 0.747, ρ 0.976 | drop WL3 → 1009, 0.601, ρ 0.937 | drop WL1 → 394, 0.541, ρ 0.976 | drop WL2 → 391, 0.533, ρ 0.974.
- Per-sample group-relative deviation (median |log2 dev|, baseMean>10): **KL3 0.479 > WL3 0.340 > KL1 0.262 ≈ KL2 0.256** → KL3 sabse noisy sample hai (size factor 0.816 ke anuroop).
- **Nishkarsh:** gene **ordering** stable hai (ρ 0.91–0.98), par DE **count/gene-set** stable nahi (391–1009, Jaccard 0.53–0.76). Isliye 722-gene set ko approximate DE set padha jaye; kisi bhi enrichment nishkarsh ke liye DESeq2/limma + adhik replicates chahiye. λ_GC 3.67 (primary) bhi yahi kehta hai.

**2) Blocked final deliverable + reproducibility:** pathway answer nahi diya gaya hai. `python3 analysis/run_analysis.py` do baar chala kar dekha — saare CSV/TSV + summary.json **byte-identical (md5 verified)**, ~2m50s, seed 20261025. Chalne par GSEA apne-aap chal jayega jaise hi (a) `gseapy` ya `KEGG_2019_Mouse.gmt` aur (b) koi real Ensembl→symbol table `/workspace` ke neeche mil jaye — script dono auto-detect karta hai, tab primary + reverse prerank, NES nominal p, FDR q aur leading-edge `out/gsea_primary.csv` / `gsea_reverse.csv` me likhe jayenge.

**Direction abhi bhi assumption:** UBE2M (ENSMUSG00000062980) KL vs WL = baseMean 18.92, log2FC −0.701 (shrunken −0.294), p 0.0619, padj 0.163 → KL me kam, par significant nahi; isliye KL=KD fact nahi, flagged assumption hi hai.

payload.gsea_ranking_metric: shrunken log2FC x (-log10 raw Wald p); p floored at 1e-300; NaN/all-zero dropped; baseMean>=10; ties by (shrunk log2FC desc, geneID asc); duplicate symbols collapsed by mean; min_size 15 / max_size 500; log2FC-only alternative list also written
payload.reproducible: two independent runs produced byte-identical outputs (md5 verified)
blockers: gseapy not importable in the executed runtime
no file-backed KEGG_2019_Mouse gene set library
no real Ensembl->symbol mapping source (0/21884 mapped)
payload.what_would_finish_it: supply gseapy (or KEGG_2019_Mouse.gmt) plus a real Ensembl->symbol table under /workspace; run_analysis.py auto-detects both and writes gsea_primary.csv and gsea_reverse.csv with NES, nominal p, FDR q and leading-edge for both directions
